blocks.text: Fossil women's handbags are built to be your stylish staples, your classic fashion pieces and your functional favorites. Our designers combine high-quality materials with unique details and silhouettes to create bags that go beyond storage (although there's a lot of that).

items.label: Editor's Notes
items.value: Let's talk smalls: the Kinley small crossbody is your mini bag that packs a (pretty) punch. Its eye-catching exterior pocket makes it one of our favorite bags to carry.

items.label: Premium Craftsmanship
items.value: Genuine Leather & Fabric Crossbody Bag; Zipper Closure with Hidden Magnetic Snap; imported

items.label: It's all in the Details
items.value: Exterior Details: 1 Back Slide Pocket, 1 Front Slide Pocket; Interior Details: 1 Slide Pocket, 1 Zipper Pocket

items.label: Style Essentials
items.value: Fossil women's handbags are built to be your stylish staples, classic fashion pieces and your functional favorites. Our designers combine high-quality materials with unique details and silhouettes to create bags that go beyond storage.

items.label: Material Features
items.value: Durable leather with polyurethane coating and gold-toned hardware

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Hand wash separately in cold water. Do not bleach. Do not iron. Avoid direct sunlight and heat sources. Condition leather periodically.
